title: Oil Rig Workers Train Upside Down Underwater
asof: Figures as of 2026 · full video on the channel

shots.s: Before you can work on a North Sea oil rig, you have to escape this.
Almost everyone flies out to the rigs by helicopter.
So you train for the worst.
A mock helicopter cabin is dropped into a pool,
You practice getting out, underwater, in the dark.
It's required for everyone flying offshore by helicopter.
Shoulders twenty-two inches or more? Extra-broad.
You sit next to the bigger windows,
so you can still squeeze out in a survival suit.
